hits.name: Firefox
hits.description: When it comes to your life online, you have a choice: accept the factory settings or put your privacy first. When you choose Firefox as your default browser, you’re choosing to protect your data while supporting an independent tech company. Firefox is also the only major browser backed by a non-profit fighting to give you more openness, transparency and control of your life online. Join hundreds of millions of people who choose to protect what's important by choosing Firefox - a web browser designed to be fast, easy to use, customizable and private.

hits.name: Add Water
hits.description:
A utility app to easily install the Firefox GNOME Theme* and automatically update it in the background. This theme keeps Firefox fashionable within the GNOME design ecosystem, and provides many helpful features to customize the interface to make browsing even more pleasant:
		
      
        Supports light and dark style, as well as accent colors
        Hide Tab Bar when only one tab is open
        Use an OLED-friendly pitch black for the interface
        Customize Tab Bar position, position of controls, alignment, and more
        Hide redundant microphone, webcam, screen share indicators
        Supports Flatpak, Snap, Librewolf, and Floorp variants of Firefox
      
      *The Firefox GNOME Theme itself is independently developed and maintained by Rafael Mardojai CM.
      The Firefox browser is not included and must be downloaded separately. This project is not affiliated or endorsed by the Mozilla Foundation. Firefox is a trademark of the Mozilla Foundation in the U.S. and other countries.

hits.name: FlameGet
hits.description:
Accelerate your downloads, grab videos from your favorite sites, and manage everything from a beautiful, modern interface.
      
        Clean, simple, and easy-to-use interface
        Support for BitTorrent and Magnet links
        Support for video links
        Selective file downloading for torrents
        Automatic daily tracker list updates
        Customizable User-Agent
        Customizable post-downlad commands
        System notifications upon download completion
        System tray integration for quick access
        Native CSS customization mode support
        Optionally delete downloaded files when removing tasks
        Available in multiple languages

hits.name: Flow
hits.description:
Flow is an opinionated modern browser focused on productivity and privacy. With a clean, minimalistic user interface, it helps you focus on your work and get things done quickly.
    
      Features that make it stand out:
      
        Clean, collapsible sidebar
        Spaces to organise your work
        Command palette to quickly open a new tab, bookmark, or history
        Supports most streaming services via Widevine

hits.name: Wavebox
hits.summary: The next generation of web-desktop communication
hits.description:
With customizable toolbars, sleeping tabs, cookie containers, and multiple profiles,
      Wavebox has everything you need to work better across Slack, Asana, Gmail, Teams,
      Figma, and all your other daily web tools.
    
      
        Tab organizing, sleep, and search.
        Containers for multi-accounts.
        Profiles for multiple setups.
        High performance, longer battery life.
        Zero ads or tracking.

hits.name: Floorp
hits.description:
Unlimited Customization For Everyone
      Enable more advanced customization than your default browser. Floorp is based on the smart Firefox, and enhances functionality and flexibility while maintaining security and privacy.
      What can Floorp do for you?
      
        Flexible UI Customization: Floorp's most distinctive feature is its customizability. Floorp is the first Firefox-based browser to enable UI customization, designed so that anyone can easily adjust their browsing experience to their preferences and access the web with ease.
        Various Ways to Browse the Web: Floorp features workspaces that integrate tab groups with containers that can separate login information. Additionally, you can easily access social media and chats through web panels.
        Various Control Methods Supported: Browse more efficiently with mouse gestures and customizable keyboard shortcuts. Of course, it's also designed to be easily operated with a mouse.
        Development and Research Focused: Floorp actively pursues experimental browser development. It's a browser that continuously incorporates new technologies and ideas, and energetically improves based on community feedback.
        Aiming for a Sustainable Web: We respect users' rights and contribute to building an open and sustainable web ecosystem. Let's create the future of the internet together for the next generation.

hits.name: Surfshark
hits.description:
Protect yourself with the Surfshark VPN bundle for Linux!
      
      Surfshark VPN app protects you on both public and private Wi-Fi. It offers a VPN with global server infrastructure, an integrated ad blocker, a dedicated IP option, and many features like double VPN. 
      Independently audited by Deloitte, Surfshark VPN doesn't track your activity and keeps it safe. Surfshark has 4,500+ RAM-only servers with speeds of at least 10 Gbps and reaching 100 Gbps in the most crowded areas.
      Surfshark’s servers located in 100 countries worldwide are connected to an industry-first self-healing infrastructure Everlink that ensures even better VPN connection stability.
      
        Protect the entire household:
      
      Forget counting devices. With a single subscription, you'll get unlimited simultaneous connections. Connect and protect all your household devices with Surfshark VPN.
      
        Secure your data and privacy:
      
      Your ISP can see the websites you visit and the products you look for. With a VPN and its end-to-end encryption, your browsing remains private.
      
        Surf with blazing speeds:
      
      Surfshark offers 4,500+ servers in 100 countries. Use your favorite apps or browse websites lag-free with a secure and fast VPN connection.
      
        Keep your data private:
      
      Surfshark has a no-activity-logs policy, proven by audits, which ensures we don't see or collect your online activity.
      
        Stay safe on public Wi-Fi:
      
      Public Wi-Fi is a perfect space for hackers. And even more dangers might hide in these networks. A VPN connection protects your data and ensures that it's safe.
      
        Access internet without censorship:
      
      Censorship or internet restrictions while traveling might stand between you and your favorite things online. That's where a secure VPN steps in and helps you access your home content.
      
        Block ads and trackers:
      
      Websites collect info about you and display ads based on your online habits. Surfshark stops those annoying ads and protects you from malware attacks.
      
        
          Discover more Surfshark Linux app features:
        
        Global server network — travel the world without leaving your room with more than 4,500 VPN servers in over 100 countries.
        Clean Web — block ads, trackers, malware, and pop-ups.
        Multi Hop — select two different servers to connect through simultaneously
        Dedicated IP — connect to your dedicated IP directly from your Linux devices.
        Everlink — get better IP protection with a self-healing mechanism that revives your connection by reconfiguring the VPN tunnel without disconnecting you from the VPN.
        24/7 customer support — get help via live chat, email, or social media. You can also check our Blog and Help Center.
      
      If you have any questions, contact us directly at support@surfshark.com or via live chat.

hits.name: FSearch
hits.description:
FSearch helps you to find files and folders as easy and fast as possible.
            Just type a few letters and search results will appear almost instantly.
        
      
            There are a lot of features which make searching as efficient and powerful
            as possible. Such as:
        
      
        Ignore case (e.g. searching for "fsearch" will match "FSearch" as well)
        Regular expressions
        Wildcard support
        Filter support (e.g. only search for audio files)
        Exclude certain files and folders
        Fast sort by name, path, size, modification time and extension
      
      Note: Due to Flatpak's sandboxing, FSearch can't find every file on your system.

hits.name: LibreWolf
hits.description:
LibreWolf
      This project is an independent fork of Firefox, with the primary goals of privacy security and user freedom. It is the community run successor to LibreFox.
      LibreWolf uses more than 500 privacy/security/performance settings, patches, LibreWolf-Addons (optional) and is designed to minimize data collection and telemetry as much as possible (updater, crashreporter and Firefox’s integrated addons that don’t respect privacy are removed).
      LibreWolf is NOT associated with Mozilla or its products.
      Features:
      
        Latest Version of Firefox: LibreWolf is compiled directly from the latest build of Firefox Stable. You will have the the latest features, and security updates.
        Completely Independent Build: LibreWolf uses a completely independent build from Firefox and has its own settings, profile folder and installation path. As a result, it can be installed alongside Firefox or any other browser.
        Settings protection: important settings are enforced/locked within librewolf.cfg and policies.json, those settings cannot be changed by addons/updates/LibreWolf itself or unwanted/accidental manipulation; To change those settings you can easily do it by editing librewolf.cfg and policies.json.
        LibreWolf-addons: set of optional LibreWolf extensions
        Statistics disabled: telemetry and similar functions are disabled
        Tested settings: settings are performance aware
        Recommended and code reviewed addons list
        Community-Driven
        And much more…
